notes: Deployment was silently broken (two defects, found 2026-08-02 while deploying the T265 fix). (1) bin/ held a stale binary: bin/weizigo-gtp was the pre-fix engine while zig-out/bin had the fix; sabaki.md points Sabaki at bin/, so the human would have replayed the fixed bug. Caught only because T264's version stamp made the two comparable. (2) cp over a live binary yields exit=137 on Apple Silicon: replacing a signed binary in place invalidates the cached signature and the kernel SIGKILLs it — no message, just silence. The repair is rm && cp && codesign -s -; every deploy step in build.zig used a bare cp. FIXED: tools/deploy.sh implements the remove-copy-sign recipe once; build.zig's deploy-absorb / deploy-managent / deploy-gtp steps now invoke it, and a new umbrella 'zig build deploy' runs all three. Verified: deployed copies run and carry valid ad-hoc arm64 signatures (codesign -dv). FIXED (checker): tools/smoke.sh and tools/regression-managent-integrity.sh now execute the DEPLOYED bin/ copies and compare their version stamps ('<tool> <sha>[-dirty]') with zig-out/ — a stale bin/ fails the suite. Calibrated with a known-bad control: planting bin/weizigo-gtp as bin/managent (same sha, wrong tool) FAILS the regression with 'deployed bin/weizigo-gtp c344f02-dirty != built zig-out/managent c344f02-dirty' — the tool name is part of the compared token because a same-sha wrong-tool binary passed the first draft of the check (that draft was caught by the control and hardened). gen-version.sh used `git diff --quiet` without --cached, so staged-but-uncommitted changes did not set the dirty flag — the stamp claimed a provenance it did not have; now both staged and unstaged diffs are checked (doc updated in docs/infra/versioning.md). Retired the root-hazard binaries ./managent (pre-T264, writes the same tasks.json — two writers to one kanban is a corruption path) and ./gtp (a misnamed weizigo-oracle, superseded by bin/weizigo-gtp); both deleted from disk (gitignored, nothing references them). OBSERVED, out of scope: bin/weizigo-claimlint was older than src/claimlint.zig and printed no version banner (pre-T264 build; the current source prints it), corroborating GRAND-AUDIT §3; the deployed claimlint is now refreshed by the deploy step like every other tool. A full zig build succeeded only after a concurrent agent's mid-edit claimlint.zig state was fixed (the tree is being edited in parallel; this task's commit is scoped strictly to its own paths). No battery reading may be quoted as a Phase 1 gate result until this closes; bin/ now equals zig-out by construction and by check.
